## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior and new behavior.

## Validation

List the exact meaningful checks and results. Mark unavailable private-spec or
live checks explicitly; do not count a skip as a pass.

- [ ] Relevant regression tests, lint, formatting, typecheck and build
- [ ] Generated catalog/tool surface refreshed when affected
- [ ] Package/container smoke checks for runtime, packaging or release changes
- [ ] Identity, location/chain scope, read-only, confirmation and no-retry gates preserved
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility impact reviewed

## Remaining limitations

State real blockers and cross-PR dependencies. Independent approval and required
CI are needed before merging; this checklist does not replace repository rules.
